data.long_meaning: The name Jeniffer is derived from the Greek name Iouana, which is believed to be a variant of the Hebrew name Hannah. The name means 'gracious, merciful, or favor' in Greek, and 'God is gracious' in Hebrew. In Christian tradition, the name is associated with the biblical character Hannah, who was barren until she prayed to God and was granted a son, Samuel.
